name: Web document — GitHub (vertical)
description: Vertical (TikTok/Reels) reflow of the GitHub issue overlay — the card widens to the vertical safe-area while the look holds. Faithful site look BY DESIGN: GitHub dark mode (canvas #0d1117, the owner/repo breadcrumb, the issue title, a green Open badge, and a bordered comment with the author's avatar + 'username commented on …' header), inside a browser window whose address bar shows the URL — NO Syntax collage chrome (no torn edge / grit / hard offset shadow), and NO CSS glow on the captured card. Because the page is dark, the highlight runs in the dark-surface mode — the light comment text is punched to dark ink under the amber band so it stays readable. The emissive 'web page on a backlit display' look is a TypeGPU shaderPass (subpixel emission, backlight bloom, escaping-bezel halo, viewport-edge defocus), not Pack chrome. ~6s: card settles in, the highlighter draws over the hero line (~1.2→2.4s), then a long static hold a creator can freeze/extend. Transparent WebM overlay, composited over footage.

content.title: Build time regressed ~4x after the v2 bundler swap
content.author: wesbos
content.body: Spent the afternoon bisecting this. It's not the bundler — [highlight]a stray console.log inside a hot loop was firing on every file[/highlight]. Removing it drops the build from 40s back to ~9s. PR incoming.
